title: Digital IDs Work At More Than 250 Airport Checkpoints
hook: Plastic is no longer the only ID option at hundreds of checkpoints.
closing: Digital IDs are spreading, but travelers still need a physical backup.
question: Would you trust a phone ID?

segments.say: Only 11 states first let airport security scan a digital ID. Adoption has since nearly doubled.
More than 250 checkpoints now accept digital ID, putting phone credentials in far more airport lines.
Digital ID works in 20 states, still less than half the country. Most travelers need plastic as backup.
